command: GROK_HOME=<empty temp dir> grok login --oauth against grok-1.0.70-macos-aarch64, killed after it printed its sign-in prompt
method: The URL is read from the CLI's own stdout prompt in parity/oauth-rea-2026-10-31/grok/login-probe.txt. No browser was opened, no code was approved. Parameter set, order, client_id, scope, and referrer match the 1.0.50 capture; only redirect_uri port, code_challenge, state, and nonce differ per run.

stableParameters.scope: openid profile email offline_access grok-cli:access api:access conversations:read conversations:write workspaces:read workspaces:write

stateAndNonceShape: UUID; both values in one run share a timestamp prefix
notes: No access token, refresh token, email, or user id is recorded. The authorize URL is a request the CLI would open; it was never approved. The 1.0.50 fixture remains as historical reference.
